name: keith-barney-portfolio
description: Keith Barney - Design Systems Designer Portfolio

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build:pages
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/css dist/fonts && cp ~/Projects/design/heavy-design-system/dist/main.css dist/css/main.css && cp src/assets/fonts/* dist/fonts/ && cd dist/css && ln -sf ../fonts fonts
scripts.build:pages: cp site-nav.css dist/site-nav.css && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp resume.html dist/resume.html && cp project-template.html dist/project-template.html && cp atlas-component-docs.html dist/atlas-component-docs.html && cp history.html dist/history.html && cp atlas-branch-manager.html dist/atlas-branch-manager.html && cp atlas-annotate.html dist/atlas-annotate.html

author: Keith Barney
